verdict.rationale: Formant stores fleet telemetry, so controlling retention and deletion is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows ingestion-side controls: choosing which streams upload to the cloud, per-stream rate limits, and low-bandwidth mode. Those are adjacent features, not retention periods or data deletion, and nothing in the pack documents retention settings or a way to delete stored data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
